title: Backup scheduling model
intent: Bahia owns canonical backup schedule intent and dispatch state for BackupDefinition records.
observed_behavior_before: BackupDefinition contained schedule expression, enabled, and jitter metadata fields.
Backup execution was request/queue-driven and no service evaluated recurring schedules.
No durable table tracked next scheduled run, last scheduled dispatch, pause/disable state, or missed runs.
intended_behavior: A service evaluates enabled BackupDefinition schedules deterministically and creates idempotent queued BackupRun records when due.
Schedule state tracks next scheduled run, last scheduled dispatch, last scheduled due slot, pause/disable lifecycle, maintenance window, and missed runs.
Jitter and maintenance windows are applied before dispatch without sleep-based tests or timeout-based completion logic.
scope: internal/service backup scheduler evaluation and dispatch logic
internal/db migration 000032 for backup schedule states
non_goals: No controlplane handler/reactor changes in this slice
No backup backend adapter changes in this slice
